name: Hiiden Hirvi
body:
HIIDEN HIRVI
CR 5

This clattering monstrosity is shaped like a large skull-headed elk but cobbled together from bones, gnarled sticks, twisted thorn-vines, and tattered animal hides. Its eyes glow faintly and mist trails from its empty jaws.

XP 1,600
CE Large construct
Init +5; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, –1 size)
hp 68 (7d10+30)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2
DR 5/slashing; Immune construct traits
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee gore +11 (1d8+6 plus trip), 2 hooves +6 (1d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks powerful charge (gore, 2d8+12 and knocked prone), roar

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 13, Con —, Int 4, Wis 10, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +13; CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Nimble Moves, Skill Focus (Perception, Stealth)
Skills Disguise +2 (+10 as elk), Perception +6, Stealth +4 (+8 in forests); Racial Modifiers +8 Disguise to impersonate elk, +4 Stealth in forests
Languages Common, Goblin, Sylvan (cannot speak)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Roar (Ex)

As a standard action, a hiiden hirvi can emit an incredible roar. Each creature within 20 feet must succeed at a DC 15 Will saving throw or be frightened until the end of the hiiden hirvi’s next turn. The hiiden hirvi can’t roar again for 1d4 rounds. The save DC is Strength-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold or temperate forests
Organization solitary, pair, or ambush (1 plus 2–8 goblins or twigjacks)
Treasure none

This twisted creature resembles an elk, but it is actually a facsimile created by goblin witches or fey from wood and branches in the forest. Its body is made of wood; its antlers are willow branches; its skin is bark. It loves to create chaos and destruction, and lures hunters through treacherous mountains to their doom. A hiiden hirvi is built to dimensions resembling an impressive bull elk—7 or 8 feet long—but are hollow and weigh only about 75 pounds.
